research_claim_unchanged: A bounded, auditable four-component PM can conditionally route response resources and outperform scientifically matched fixed policies under one shared executor.
problem_closed_by_this_version: Rank-1 is a retrieval object, not automatically generator-ready evidence. The old executor conflated component selection, evidence realization, and multi-resource composition.
causal_pipeline: quality, risk, function, and cost measurement

MP.generator_behavior: change format, burden, timing, or practical framing; do not cite the profile merely to prove use
MP.minimum_function: an observable response choice changes because of an active preference or directly relevant stable constraint

MS.realization_unit: one source-exact informative seeker turn selected from actual Rank-1 using current visible seeker text only
MS.generator_behavior: use as a past reference with an explicit opening for whether it still applies now
MS.minimum_function: the span prevents redundant exploration or materially connects a specific prior focus to the current request

ME.realization_unit: source-exact past action plus observed result
ME.generator_behavior: offer the past action/result as one optional analogy, never as a rule, cause, or guarantee
ME.minimum_function: the action-result pair changes a present option or interpretation without overgeneralization

RS.generator_behavior: execute exactly one atomic support move
RS.minimum_function: the selected support move is actually performed and remains the reply's primary discourse act

joint_rules.unknown_redundant_or_conflicting_MS_ME: retain the higher frozen PM score, with deterministic ME tie-break, and record the suppressed component
joint_rules.missing_safe_realization: project that component OFF and record NO_SAFE_REALIZED_RESOURCE
joint_rules.forbidden_prompt_rule: do not tell the generator that every retrieved item is useful and must be used

MS_exact_span_selector.query: all currently visible seeker turns only
MS_exact_span_selector.pool: exact seeker turns inside frozen actual Rank-1 session
MS_exact_span_selector.closed_structural_filter: remove only greetings, thanks, acknowledgements, bare backchannels, and empty turns
MS_exact_span_selector.ranker: the same frozen local BAAI/bge-m3 normalized CLS encoder
MS_exact_span_selector.output: one exact source span; no summary or paraphrase
MS_exact_span_selector.abstention: if no informative exact span exists, project MS OFF before generation

what_this_does_not_solve: EvoEmo author ancestry is positive-only session lineage and is not an exhaustive current-usefulness oracle
MP still needs active-trigger and response-transformation suitability rather than profile presence
ME still needs adequate typed action-result coverage and transfer-condition variation
a correct composition plan does not guarantee a low-capacity head can learn from few independent owner groups
generator functional uptake and downstream net benefit still require same-stack outcome evidence
